# serverguard24_nodes (Data Source)

Retrieves all available Serverguard24 monitoring nodes (probe locations).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "serverguard24_nodes" "all" {}

output "nodes" {
  value = data.serverguard24_nodes.all.nodes
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `nodes` (Attributes List) List of monitoring nodes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--nodes))

<a id="nestedatt--nodes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `nodes`

Read-Only:

- `country` (String) Country where the node is located.
- `country_code` (String) ISO country code.
- `ipv4` (String) IPv4 address of the node.
- `ipv6` (String) IPv6 address of the node.
- `location` (String) Location name of the node.
- `region` (String) Region where the node is located.
- `region_code` (String) Region code.
